review.reviewScope: Read-only source binding review of the fixed Qwen heap wrapper (QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt + HeapWrapperChecks.kt) and its bound modules (QwenTwoStageCore, QwenFileReport, QwenFileInputs, QwenFileActivity, QwenArenaPolicy) plus supplied package/host receipts. Covers only SOURCE BINDINGS and boundary/error-path correctness, NOT production quality, runtime effects, device evidence, or full-W3 closure. I did not run/build/test/device anything; package-verified.json and host-result.json are parent-supplied and treated as unexecuted-by-me.

verifications.sevenLabelsPresentAndOrdered: Happy-path order: initial-before-report -> constructor-before -> constructor-returned -> core-persist (repeats per sub-step of the single case) -> case-returned -> recognizer-released -> activity-torn-down. Exactly 7 distinct label strings; total events expected ~21 (within 8..128).
verifications.samplingFailureBlocksNative: HeapBoundaryRecorder.capture throws on the first non-cleanup sampling fault (firstFault set, re-thrown unless cleanup); initial-before-report (QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt:219) is non-cleanup, so a fault there aborts before any native dispatch; core-persist faults likewise break the case loop and stop further decode.
verifications.cleanupNeverFalsifiesRelease: recognizer-released (QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt:443) and activity-torn-down (QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt:477) use cleanup=true. state.recognizerReleaseSucceeded/teardownAck are written BEFORE the cleanup capture, and cleanup captures never throw, so a telemetry fault cannot overwrite a real successful release nor skip the final report.
verifications.acquiredResourcesAlwaysReleased: Streams released by core finally releaseAll (QwenTwoStageCore.kt:256-258); recognizer released once in wrapper finally when acquired!=null (QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt:422-444); Activity finish+destroy-wait in wrapper finally when act!=null (QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt:447-473). Constructor failure leaves recognizer null so no release attempt (matches 'constructor failure counts attempt without release').
verifications.separateErrorChannels: Primary core/decode error -> state.errorClass (set before any heap capture, never overwritten by err()/telemetry). Persistence write fault -> state.wrapperPersistErrorClass. Telemetry fault -> heapRecorder.errorClass. Three channels preserved independently on simultaneous decode+heap failure.
verifications.snapshotNoCallbacksExplicitNulls: arenaSnapshot wraps pure QwenFileReport.snapshot (no IO/native/callbacks); heapEvents come only from HeapBoundaryRecorder.eventsSnapshot() which deep-copies existing events and performs no new capture. Missing bytes/elapsed emitted as JSONObject.NULL.
verifications.limit128AndMonotonic: events.size>=128 treated as fault and no further event added (QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt:527-532). elapsedRealtimeNanos require non-negative and non-decreasing (lastElapsed tracked); seq=events.size is monotonic 0..127.
verifications.fixed65OnlyIndex25: QwenFileInputs.verifyAll requires 65 cases (QwenFileInputs.kt:145); wrapper requires inputs.size==65 and inputs[25].id=='fleurs-en_us-1776' (QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt:247-248); selectedInputs=listOf(inputs[25]) only (QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt:249) -> single row, no other input replayed.
verifications.exactTwoStageConfigPolicy: TwoStageCaseRunner runs exactly auto then forced-English stage (QwenTwoStageCore.kt:201-252); buildConfig featureDim=128, maxTotalLen=512, maxNewTokens=128, temperature=1e-6, topP=0.8, seed=42, numThreads=2 (QwenFileReport.kt:204-226). cfg.provider bound to arenaReceipt.provider; report microphoneStarts=0, networkRequests=0; no microphone/network/extra-native calls in wrapper.
verifications.policyBindingTruthful: QwenArenaPolicy.prepare/verify writes+reverifies 'EnableCpuMemArena=0' under private root with symlink-ancestry rejection and bounded read; receipt re-bound by computed canonical path; report sets nativePolicyEffectVerified=false and allocatorPolicy only as requested metadata (no claimed native effect).
verifications.sourceIdentity: Reviewed .kt SHA256 values equal those in candidate-accepted.json and manifest.json (QwenHeapInstrumentation b3df42e7, QwenTwoStageCore 2d14b1a3, QwenFileReport 74cb2ab4, QwenFileInputs 02567c13, QwenFileActivity dd859f76, QwenArenaPolicy c86b96b68, HeapWrapperChecks 892342a6), confirming the reviewed files match the accepted/frozen source.

limitations: Cannot independently rerun package-verified.json tools: the claims of compiled Kotlin, zero permissions, 65 test assets, and four unchanged native libraries are parent-supplied receipts, not re-executed here.

host-result.json (parent 33 groups / 274 assertions, plus pure collector 13 groups / 100 passed) is supplied evidence, not rerun; it is not device/RSS proof. deviceOperations=0 and nativePolicyEffectVerified=false confirm no device evidence was produced.
Decline all runtime-effect, device-RSS, allocator-consumption, and full-W3 closure judgments; this lane only certifies source bindings against spec.md.

verifiedInputCount is 0 in pre-verification running snapshots (set to 65 only after inputs verify at QwenHeapInstrumentation.kt:250); final/terminal report carries 65. Not a defect since contract freeze targets the terminal report, but noted as a source-observable intermediate value.
